name: Oosaka Tomoya
source:
3rd year university student.
Star Sign: Capricorn
Hobby: Cooking
Likes: All Kinds of Sweets, Flowers
Dislikes: Sour Food, All Kinds of Sports

An underclassman of the protagonist's. His family runs a flower arranging school.
An earnest guy who sometimes has trouble saying what's on his mind.
He has the habit of apologizing for things even when it isn't his fault.
